content.title: PLAB Q3 Deep Dive: High-End Demand, Regional Expansion, and Outsourcing Trends Shape Outlook
content.summary: Semiconductor photomask manufacturer Photronics (NASDAQ:PLAB) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 CY2025, but sales fell by 3.1% year on year to $215.8 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($221 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 6.7% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.60 per share was 34.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
